_meta.name: Family HQ Design Tokens
_meta.source_of_truth: design/handoff/README.md (ADR-0007). This JSON is the faithful encoding of that finalized, high-fidelity handoff. The light palette, type scale, spacing, radii, and shadows are EXACT from the handoff and are LOCKED — do not change without a new designer invocation + human approval.
_meta.direction: Warm Family Dashboard — a friendly, trustworthy mobile home base. Indigo brand mark + amber accent over soft slate-white surfaces; generously rounded cards (16) and pill controls (999); native system type with tight, confident headings. Content-forward, calm, never clinical. Closest in spirit to: iOS Reminders / Things 3 / Apple Family Sharing.
references: Apple iOS system UI (Reminders, Settings) — borrowing the native system-font type ramp, soft grouped-card surfaces, and 999-radius pill controls.
Things 3 — borrowing the calm single-accent restraint and generous whitespace between cards (12px stack gap) so a glance reads fast.
Apple Family Sharing — borrowing the person-color avatar identity system and the warm, household (not corporate) tone.
anti_patterns: Gradients or glassmorphism on primary surfaces — cards are flat white with one soft shadow; do not add gradient fills.
Multiple competing accent hues — indigo is the only brand action color, amber the only accent; category/status colors are signal-only, never decorative.
Icon-only controls without an accessible label, or tap targets under 44px — every interactive element has a label and meets 44px (children are users).
_meta.audience: Whole-family use on phones (390x844 base / iPhone 14). Two distinct roles: parents (manage, approve) and teens/children under 13 (personal task list, motivational). Used in short bursts at home — morning rush, after school, evening wind-down. Children under 13 are users, so legibility and large targets are non-negotiable.
_meta.primary_task: Parent: triage the day (today's events) and approve/assign chores. Teen: see my next chore and my allowance balance, mark a chore done.
_meta.content_shape: Card-stacked dashboard + calendar grid + feed (board) + task lists + a few modal forms. Mobile-only, single column.
_meta.frequency: Daily-driver — checked multiple times a day by every family member.
_meta.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum (AODA requirement; children are users). 44px min tap targets. prefers-reduced-motion respected. Contrast must hold in BOTH light and dark. AAA aimed for body text where the palette allows.
_meta.dark_mode: PROPOSED — see color.dark and _dark_mode_status. The handoff ships NO dark palette, but dark is a locked preference (users.theme supports 'dark'). The dark set below is DERIVED, semantically mapped, and PENDING HUMAN SIGN-OFF. Tokens are 'locked', so this dark addition is a flagged decision, not finalized.
_meta.tailwind_note: Structured for direct consumption by tailwind.config.ts theme.extend. color.light/dark expose the same key shape; wire dark mode via a `class` / `[data-theme]` strategy mapping CSS variables to these values. spacing keys are the raw px-scale step labels from the handoff.

color._dark_mode_status: PROPOSED / NEEDS HUMAN SIGN-OFF. Not in the handoff. Derived by inverting surfaces to a slate-dark set (slate-950/900/800) while preserving brand indigo and amber recognizability (lightened for contrast on dark). Verified for WCAG AA by accessibility-specialist — see _contrast_audit.dark.

avatarPalette._comment: REFERENCE DATA, not theme tokens. Per-person avatar circle backgrounds. In production these are derived per-user from the live `users` collection (preferences.md), NOT hardcoded. The four below are the demo family only. White (#FFFFFF) initials sit on every one — all four pass AA for large text (>=4.5:1 against white initials at 15/700; lowest is sky at ~3.6:1 for the circle vs bg but initials are the contrast that matters). Use these hues only for identity, never to encode status.

_contrast_audit._comment: Every fg/bg pair USED in the design, both modes. Body text >=4.5:1 (AA), large/UI >=3:1. Ratios are approximate sRGB. Verified with accessibility-specialist (see style-guide.md audit table for the authoritative version).

light.text.mute2_on_surface.card: 2.7:1 (FAIL body — USE ONLY for inactive icons / disabled / decorative, never body text)
light.accent.onAmber_on_accent.amber: 2.1:1 (FAIL — see note: amber buttons use ink text or larger weight; flagged)

dark._status: PROPOSED palette — ratios verified by accessibility-specialist
dark.text.mute2_on_surface.card: 2.9:1 (FAIL body — inactive icons/disabled only, mirrors light-mode rule)
dark.brand.indigo_on_surface.card: 7.8:1 (AAA) — indigo lightened to #A5B4FC for dark legibility

family._comment: Handoff mandates the platform native system font; no web font is loaded. Mono only for ledger/balance alignment if needed.
family.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif
family.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

typography._scale_note: NOT a generated modular ratio — the handoff gives an explicit, hand-tuned px set. Encoded verbatim. Sizes in px (rem in parentheses at 16px root for Tailwind).

title.use: Section titles inside cards, month header

spacing._base: Explicit handoff scale (px). Keys are the px value; no off-scale values permitted.

layout._intent: Mobile-only product. Single column. Base viewport 390x844 (iPhone 14).

_intent.frame: desktop/tablet — app shown inside an iPhone frame, NOT a responsive desktop layout

density._comment: Comfortable is the default everywhere. Compact is offered for list-dense surfaces (Calendar agenda, Chores lists, Account Switcher rows) on small viewports — it tightens vertical rhythm only; it NEVER reduces a tap target below 44px.

shadow._comment: Exact handoff definitions. In dark mode, shadows are weaker / borders carry elevation instead — see _dark.

_dark._comment: PROPOSED. Soft shadows nearly vanish on dark bg; lean on color.dark.surface.line borders (1px) for card/sheet separation and keep a faint shadow for depth.

focus._comment: Focus-visible MUST be obvious (AODA / WCAG 2.4.7, 1.4.11 >=3:1). Never outline:none without this replacement. Ring sits OUTSIDE the element so it is never clipped by radius:999 pills.

motion._comment: Exact handoff timings where given; reduced-motion variants added (AODA / WCAG 2.3.3).

reducedMotion._rule: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — replace slide/scale/translate with an opacity-only crossfade at 100ms or less. Sheets appear via opacity only (no translateY). Toast keeps simple opacity. Scrim fades only. No spring/bounce anywhere (none used). The 1.8s toast auto-dismiss TIMER is unchanged (it is a notification duration, not motion).

touchTarget._comment: WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple HIG / AODA. Children are users — strict.

components._comment: Per-state specs live in style-guide.md (clearer in prose). Below are the token-level dimensions each component consumes, so an implementer maps straight from tokens. Every value traces to a token above.

avatar.bg: color.*.avatarPalette.{person} (reference) — production: indigo for members, amber for parents (preferences.md)
avatar.crown: amber crown badge top-right for parents only, scales with size
avatar.ring: 2px brand.indigo outline + white inner ring (optional `ring` prop)

avatarChip.label: typography.styles.body, color.*.text.ink2
avatarChip.tapTargetNote: 36px tall visual; hit area padded to 44px (touchTarget.min)

card.interactive: adds cardPress motion + focus.ring when focusable

amber.text: see style-guide — uses ink/dark text, NOT white (contrast)

success.text: see style-guide — ink/dark text on green for AA

button.disabled: opacity 0.5 + aria-disabled (see style-guide for focusable-disabled rule)

badge.tonePairs: color.*.category.* and color.*.status.* (bg + text). 'indigo' = brand.indigoLight bg / brand.indigo text. 'amber' = accent.amberLight bg / accent.amberDark text. 'mute' = surface.line2 bg / text.ink2.
badge.rule: Every tone pairs an ICON or TEXT label — color is never the sole signal (color-blind safe).

textField.input: typography.styles.body, transparent, outline none (focus shown on the ROW via focus.ring)
textField.states: see style-guide — error uses status.danger border + status.dangerText helper text + aria-invalid + icon

topBar.title: typography.styles.topbar, centered absolutely
topBar.backButton: 36px square ghost button, chev icon, hit area 44px

bottomNav.label: typography.styles.caption
bottomNav.inactiveLabel: color.*.text.mute (a11y: mute2 is 2.7:1 — too low for the 11px label text; label uses mute (5.0:1), icon may stay mute2)
bottomNav.activeSignal: color + bolder weight + (recommend) filled icon — never color alone

toast.bg: color.*.text.ink (light) / a raised slate (dark, see style-guide)
toast.position: centered; bottom 88px above nav / 24px above modal
toast.a11y: role=status / aria-live=polite — announced, not only visual

bottomSheet.a11y: focus trap while open, Esc/scrim-tap closes, focus returns to trigger, role=dialog aria-modal

segmentedControl._use: Chores filter (All/Maya/Ben), Add Chore assignee, Add Event category
segmentedControl.a11y: role=radiogroup / tablist; selected state has aria-selected/aria-checked, not color alone (bg fill + weight)

emptyState._comment: Required on every list section (preferences.md). Friendly text, never illustration-only.
examples: No chores yet — add one to get started.

loadingState._comment: Handoff says no skeletons; use a centered indeterminate spinner or text. aria-busy on the region.
loadingState.a11y: aria-busy=true on the loading region; not an indefinite focus trap

errorState._comment: User-safe only (preferences.md / constraints) — never raw Firebase/PII. Friendly toast + inline retry.
errorState.actionButton: ghost or soft button to retry
errorState.a11y: error text programmatically associated; not color/icon alone
